content.title: An incredible experience awaits you at ASU | Your Future

Design a personalized college experience #1 in the U.S. for innovationahead of MIT and Stanford– U.S. News & World Report, 2016-2026#1 in the U.S. for global impactahead of Michigan State, Penn State and MIT– Times Higher Education, 2020-2024#2 in the U.S. for employability among public universitiesahead of Michigan and Purdue– U.S. News & World Report, 2026#3 in the U.S. for first-year experiencesamong public universitiesahead of Stanford, Harvard and Yale– U.S. News & World Report, 2025 Make your college experience what you want it to be, and continue on the path to who you’re becoming. Take the quizzes below and use the results to get an idea of what your college experience might be like. What do you want to study? Not sure what to major in? We’ve got you. Pick the most appealing photos in this quiz and we’ll give you three majors and three career options you might like. Take the me3 quiz to explore degrees Where do you want to live and learn? What’s your ideal living and learning environment? Lots of action? Small and quiet? Somewhere in between? This quiz will pinpoint the ASU campus that’s best for you. Take the campus fit quiz What kind of college student will you be? Knowing what kind of student you’re likely to be can help you figure out what you should look for in a college. Are you a Trailblazer? A Deep Diver? Find out. Take the experience quiz Paying for CollegeKnock out each of the tasks below to get the most financial aid possible. Send in your FAFSA Fill out the Free Application for Federal Student Aid and see how much you qualify for in federal dollars. Top-ranked programs in a city of opportunity Being located in a big city means ASU is full of big opportunities for internships and industry alliances (students can work with Mayo Clinic, NASA and Intel, to name a few). Going to school in metro Phoenix puts you close to hospitals, news outlets, the microchip industry, government offices and more, all of which — depending on your major — you’ll have access to. These are opportunities you just can’t get in smaller cities. What its like to live in Phoenix There’s so much to do in metro Phoenix — get a feel for what it’s like to live in the Valley of the Sun. The variety of experiences I get to have and people I get to meet every day — because the university has people from all over the U.S. and around the world — are what I love most about ASU and my experience so far.Willem K. ASU sports journalism major Grosse Pointe, Michigan Come and see us The best way to find out if ASU is right for you is to come for a campus visit. You’ll learn about the university and take a campus tour led by a current student who can answer all your questions about what it’s like to be a Sun Devil. Plan your visit now. How can we help? ASU has representatives that can talk through any questions you have about what makes ASU different and help you find your fit. Talk to your dedicated rep
